description: The machine-readable form of `.orcinus/state.json` (see docs/project-state.md). Enforced by scripts/state.py. A state file that says VERIFIED without an evidence_bundle is corrupt, not verified; a content change resets the stage to BUILDING. Format 3 (0.12.0): the state records HOW it was verified — `verification_origin` (a CI attestation, or a local targeted rerun run by the gate itself) and, for a local rerun, the `rerun` record. A format-2 state carries no origin and must be migrated (`state.py migrate`); a VERIFIED stage minted before 0.12 is demoted to VERIFYING by the migration, because its origin cannot be known afterwards.

approval.description: When the human approves: who approved, what content digest, and what artifact. Required (non-null, with a content_digest matching the state's) when the stage is RELEASE_READY.

content_digest.description: sha256:<hex> over the tree excluding .orcinus/ and docs/verification/ (see docs/project-state.md). This is what VERIFIED is bound to.

evidence_bundle.description: The path to the evidence bundle for the content_digest, or null when there is none (BUILDING). Required (non-null) when the stage is VERIFIED or RERUN_CONFIRMED.

format_version.description: Bump when a required field is added or a rule changes.

history.description: Every stage transition, with the revision, the content digest, and the time. Append-only; a transition is never rewritten. Each entry records the verification origin in force at that transition (null before any verification).

origin.description: The verification origin in force at this transition: CI_ATTESTED (a live CI attestation), LOCAL_RERUN (a targeted rerun run by the gate itself), or null (no verification yet).

rerun.description: The targeted rerun the gate itself ran for this content (0.12.0): the proof the rerun produced, plus when it ran. Non-null exactly when verification_origin is LOCAL_RERUN; null otherwise. Never a caller-supplied file — the gate runs the rerun and records what it did.

revision.description: The exact commit the stage refers to (full or abbreviated SHA). Human-readable pointer; the binding is the content digest.

stage.description: One of the seven lifecycle stages.

verification_origin.description: How this content was verified: CI_ATTESTED (a live CI attestation for the revision, checked at transition time — the only origin that mints VERIFIED) or LOCAL_RERUN (a targeted rerun the gate itself ran — mints RERUN_CONFIRMED, never VERIFIED). Null before any verification. A human approval never changes this value: approval is a decision, not a verification.

title: ORCINUS persistent project state
